verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a Dashboard page that shows total controls and controls with owners, and flags controls needing attention. Its Compliance Roadmap can filter Unified Controls by framework and group them by Status, so a per-framework view of control status and gaps exists. missing for 10: a documented per-framework readiness percentage, an explicit passing-versus-failing control count per framework, a 'what's left' remaining-work summary, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, a readiness view shows exactly how far I am from audit-ready per framework — passing controls, open gaps, and what's left, as one honest percentage

citations.quote: Total Controls: The total number of controls in your compliance program... Controls with Owners: The number of controls with an owner assigned to them.
If any controls need attention, Thoropass will flag them here so you can make sure you're not missing any critical compliance activity.
From the Compliance Roadmap, you can filter the list of Unified Controls by framework, and group controls by Status, Owner, Activity Type, and Milestone.
From this screen, you can quickly assess system health, investigate violations, and manage your audit readiness.
